Name: Simple House Retexture
Author: Duskwitch
Description:
This is my first retexture. Nothing fancy, just the farm house for now.
The house now has a blue roof, it's slightly desaturated, too. But I tried to stick to the vanilla style and warm color hues.
I wanted to go for a non-drastic change here.
I also removed that weird column from the last upgrade and made the wood storage a little bigger.


Install:
- unpack zip file
- backup houses.xnb in Content/Buildings
- replace file

Downloads.Description: Tweaks the colors of the vanilla farm house
